threads.subject: Scheduling: Harborview intro for Sarah Bloom

messages.body: Hi Jordan, Travis here, I coordinate for the ops team. Sarah Bloom asked me to set up an intro call re: your workflow platform. She's free Friday 8am pacific. Sending an invite unless I hear otherwise.
Sarah - pricing attached as promised, structured for your 400-person setup with the phased rollout we discussed. Also included a one-page internal pitch doc in case it helps you socialize it.
Perfect, the pitch doc is a nice touch. Will report back once I've made the rounds.

Jordan - two questions as I build the case: does the per-seat price drop at 300+ seats, and is the onboarding fee negotiable if we self-serve the training? Trying to get the number under a threshold I know will fly.
Yes on both - 300+ takes it down 12%, and we can waive half the onboarding fee for self-serve training. That puts you at the number attached. Hope that clears the threshold.
That works. This gives me what I need.
Quick update - internal review is underway, circling back after our internal review wraps. Should know more in a week or so.

threads.subject: Checking in on the internal review

messages.body: Sarah - hope the review is going well. Anything I can send that would help? Happy to do a session with Gwen or whoever is weighing in, sometimes a live walkthrough moves things faster than a deck.
